title: Meteor's Smooth PvP
description: A PvP focused modpack that improves FPS and smooths out your gameplay.
body:
A lightweight Fabric PvP modpack built for smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and better performance on Minecraft 1.21.11.

This pack is designed for players who want a responsive PvP experience without unnecessary visual clutter or distracting effects. VulkanMod helps improve rendering performance, while mods such as More Culling, Very Many Players, View Distance Fix, and Simply No Shading help keep the game running smoothly during fights and on busy servers.

Several annoying interruptions and effects are also removed, including the darkness effect, resource-pack warning screens, reloading screens, and the scoreboard. Shield Fixes improves shield behavior, while Simple Armor HUD makes it easier to keep track of your gear during combat.

**Main features:
**
* Optimized for smooth and responsive PvP
* Improved FPS and rendering performance
* Cleaner visuals with fewer distracting effects
* Fixed and improved shield behavior
* Armor durability HUD for fights
* Optional Vulkan motion blur and zoom
* Built-in proximity voice chat
* Minimal changes to the vanilla Minecraft experience

This modpack is ideal for SMPs, Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, and players who want a cleaner and more competitive Minecraft experience.
